A '''spinebeam tree''' is a tree found only within [[Daemonheim]] while [[Dungeoneering]]. It requires 40 [[Woodcutting]] to be chopped down and can yield 1-7 [[Spinebeam branches]] before depletion. Each of the logs give 145 experience. High [[complexity]] is required to find this tree whilst Dungeoneering.
